message: Decide open questions, resolve conflicts, sharpen wording

spec.title: Lunch poll idea
spec.problem: Every Friday our team wastes twenty minutes in chat arguing about where to get lunch.

users.text: It's for small office teams, usually 5 to 15 people.

source.text: It's for small office teams, usually 5 to 15 people.

goals.text: The goal is to pick a place in under five minutes so people stop arguing.

source.text: The goal is to pick a place in under five minutes so people stop arguing.

non_goals.text: Integrations with ordering services are out of scope.

source.text: Integrations with ordering services are out of scope.

requirements.text: Any team member can start a poll with 2 to 8 restaurant options.

source.text: Anyone on the team can start a poll with a few restaurant options.

requirements.text: A voter must be able to cast a vote in at most 2 taps from the poll link, in a phone or laptop browser.

source.text: People should be able to vote fast, ideally from their phone.

requirements.text: A voter must not see how any other person voted.
The organizer must see who voted for what so they can place the order.

source.text: The organizer must see who voted for what so they can place the order.

requirements.text: The poll must close automatically 10 minutes after it opens, unless the organizer closes it sooner.

source.text: The poll must close automatically within 10 minutes.

requirements.text: A voter can change their vote until the poll closes.
Results must appear within 2 seconds of the poll closing.

source.text: Results should show within 2 seconds of the poll closing.

requirements.text: It would be nice to remember everyone's favorite places.

source.text: It would be nice to remember everyone's favorite places.

requirements.text: The tool must email every team member a reminder 2 minutes before the poll closes.

source.text: We need to send a reminder before the poll closes, Slack or email?

requirements.text: Every team member must get an email with the poll link when a poll opens.

source.text: Members must get a push notification on the mobile app when a poll opens.

requirements.text: When two or more places tie, the organizer must pick the winner from the tied places.

decisions.question: Slack or email?

source.text: We need to send a reminder before the poll closes, Slack or email?

decisions.rationale: A1 says everyone has a work email; not every team uses Slack.

decisions.question: Should ties be broken randomly or by the organizer?

source.text: Should ties be broken randomly or by the organizer?

decisions.choice: the organizer picks from the tied places
decisions.rationale: The organizer places the order anyway, so they break the tie.

decisions.question: R3 says votes are anonymous but R4 says the organizer sees who voted for what. Which wins?
options: hidden from voters, visible to the organizer
decisions.choice: hidden from voters, visible to the organizer
decisions.rationale: Found in human review, not by a rule. The organizer needs names to place the order.

assumptions.text: I assume everyone already has a work email address.

source.text: I assume everyone already has a work email address.

assumptions.validation: Ask the pilot team's admin before the build starts.

assumptions.text: Probably most people will vote from a laptop anyway.

source.text: Probably most people will vote from a laptop anyway.

assumptions.validation: Count phone versus laptop votes in the first week of pilot polls.

constraints.text: Budget is one developer for two weeks.

source.text: Budget is one developer for two weeks.

constraints.text: Use the default component styles of the chosen web framework; no custom visual design in v1.
